title: McSimpleCycle
description: Recycle unwanted metal objects to reclaim precious resources
body:
McSimpleCycle
-------------

**Recycling made simple!**

Any item that uses metal in its construction can be smelted to reclaim some metal.

![The minecraft smelting screen. A copper grate is being smelted and copper nuggets are in the furnace output](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d2f5f8509778f06a4f0c7ae63c373069dfb765d5_0.webp)

- For every ingot used in its recipe 2 nuggets will be returned
- For evey 5 nuggets one will be returned (minimum one will always come back)
- For every block 18 nuggets will be reclaimed

**For example:**

Iron door: 6 iron ingots --> 3 iron doors = 2 ingots/door: recycles to 4 iron nuggets

Copper chain: 2 copper nuggets + 1 copper ingot: recycles to 3 copper nuggets
